links.outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity of LLMs versus experienced radiologist on the same breast ultrasound reports
links.effect: Radiologist sensitivity 0.989, DeepSeek-V3 0.968, ChatGPT 0.927; specificity 0.735-0.753 and PPV 0.403-0.436 comparable across models.
links.quote: The radiologist recorded the highest malignancy detection sensitivity (0.989), followed by DeepSeek-V3 (0.968) and ChatGPT (0.927).

screen.reason: This study evaluates the performance, clinical consistency, and referral safety of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3) interpreting retrospective breast ultrasound reports compared to a radiologist. It benchmarks model performance and safety metrics without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
